description: A policyholder is signing something and the wording requires a witness with no interest in the outcome. You have never met them and you will never meet them again. That is the qualification.
name: Independent Witness

objectives.desc: Sit in the claims room while somebody signs four copies.
emotes: {who} watches a man sign his own name four times and get slower at it each time.
{who} prints their own name in a box, and it looks strange, the way a word does.
